support.reason: enforcement of returned errors -- some methods can return only runtime errors; reduced risk of accidental mix-up of validation and runtime errors.
PR stands on its own and complements #35570 by cleanly separating runtime errors.
Extracting the error-part of BlockValidationState by using util::Expected is a promising direction.
explicit, value-based error handling avoids hard-to-predict invisible control flow of exceptions in mission-critical applications.
Likes the util::Expected direction over exceptions as it is easier to understand and follow.
Continued code review, identified no serious issues, and confirmed earlier comments were incorporated.
